FX-VBLUR-001.says: As added: Natural, Amount 10, Ridge Smoothness 10, the layer's own lightness as the map, Map Softness 30: a soft smear along the slopes of its blurred brightness.

FX-VBLUR-003.says: The ramp as the map, Constant Length, Amount 3, Map Softness 0: its slope runs left to right, so rows 1 to 8 are smeared straight across, 3 pixels each way, evenly.

FX-VBLUR-004.says: The same as Natural, Ridge Smoothness 10: the ramp's gentle slope, 1/15 a pixel, makes the smear 3 * 6.67 / sqrt(6.67^2 + 10^2), 1.66 pixels each way, fading.

FX-VBLUR-005.says: The same as Perpendicular: along the slope's contour, so rows are left alone and columns smeared up and down.

FX-VBLUR-006.says: Natural with Angle Offset 90: exactly Perpendicular, FX-VBLUR-005.

FX-VBLUR-007.says: A black solid as the map, Direction Center, Angle Offset 90, Amount 3: the height is 0 everywhere, so every pixel is smeared 3 pixels each way across, evenly; rows 1 to 8 are FX-VBLUR-003.

FX-VBLUR-008.says: The same as Direction Fading: only forward, from the pixels to the right.

FX-VBLUR-009.says: The ramp with Direction Center, Revolutions 1, Amount 2: the direction turns once round from black to white, straight up at the left.

FX-VBLUR-010.says: FX-VBLUR-004 with Map Softness 4: the ramp's edges soften, so the slope bends near them.

FX-VBLUR-011.says: A white disc as the map, Natural, Ridge Smoothness 0, Map Softness 0, Amount 2: smeared in and out across its rim, and nowhere else.

FX-VBLUR-012.says: The disc as Perpendicular: smeared round its rim.

FX-VBLUR-013.says: Property Alpha on the layer itself, Constant Length, Amount 2, Map Softness 0: only the pixels on the drawing's edges and round its clear corner have a slope.

FX-VBLUR-014.says: Property Hue on the layer itself, Ridge Smoothness 5, Amount 3, Map Softness 2.

FX-VBLUR-015.says: Property Saturation on the layer itself, Constant Length, Amount 2, Map Softness 2.

FX-VBLUR-016.says: FX-VBLUR-003 with Amount keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 6 at frame 4: frame 0 untouched and frame 2 is FX-VBLUR-003.

FX-VBLUR-017.says: A layer that is not in the composition, `gone`: the layer itself is the map, as FX-VBLUR-001, and the warning every frame.

FX-VBLUR-018.says: FX-VBLUR-003 on the holder moved 2 right and 1 down: the same picture moved, since the map lies on the layer.

FX-VBLUR-019.says: A type written "Natural", with a capital. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
